import pandas as pd
from sklearn.metrics import cohen_kappa_score
wide = pd.read_csv("review_labels.csv").pivot(index="review_id", columns="annotator", values="label")

def kappa(x, y):
    x, y = list(x), list(y)
    po=sum(a==b for a,b in zip(x,y))/len(x)
    pe=sum((x.count(v)/len(x))*(y.count(v)/len(y)) for v in set(x)|set(y))
    return (po-pe)/(1-pe)
kappa_ab=round(kappa(wide.аня,wide.борис),3)

import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.pipeline import make_pipeline
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.metrics import confusion_matrix

r = pd.read_csv("reviews_text.csv")
y = (r["rating"] <= 3).astype(int)
X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(r["text"], y, test_size=0.25, random_state=42, stratify=y)

m=make_pipeline(TfidfVectorizer(ngram_range=(1,2)),LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000)).fit(X_train,y_train)
tn,fp,fn,tp=confusion_matrix(y_test,m.predict(X_test)).ravel()
tpr=tp/(tp+fn)
fpr=fp/(tn+fp)
rate=n[n.shop_id=='KZN-2'].groupby('period').neg.mean()
adj=((rate-fpr)/(tpr-fpr)).round(3).to_dict()
